title: nonstandard for extreme
name: Nonstandard for extreme
rule: For particularly dangerous rare operations, require a nonstandard confirm (for example typing a word), reserved so it does not become a new habit.
pass_when: Particularly dangerous rare operations require a nonstandard confirm (e.g. typing a word), used rarely enough that it is not habitual.
fail_when: Extreme danger committed with a single OK click, or nonstandard confirm used so often it is a new habit.
overview: Rare extreme danger requires a nonstandard confirm reserved for rarity.
apply_when: Especially dangerous rare operations such as permanent account wipe.
not_when: Ordinary deletes that a standard confirm or undo already covers.
agent_hint: Require typing or similar nonstandard confirm only for rare extreme danger.
description: Particularly dangerous rare operations need more than a single OK. Require a nonstandard confirm—such as typing a word—and reserve that pattern so it does not become a new habit. Using it constantly, or letting extreme danger commit with one click, both fail. Keep standard confirms for ordinary risk; escalate only when rarity and severity justify it.
